text:
Play EA Sports FC 27. Qualify for the World Finals in Miami | PlayStation
Play EA SPORTS FC™ 27 on PlayStation® Tournaments for your chance to win a trip to the Red Bull Wings Cup World Final in Miami. Compete, qualify, and represent your country on the road to the World Final.

Everyone who participates can earn an FC 27 Red Bull Wings Kit and Red Bull Wings Cup Avatar. Finish Top 8 in the Open Qualifiers and you’ll also take home FC Points.

How it works:
• Win your Open Qualifier bracket to advance to the Closed Qualifier
• Win the Closed Qualifier to reach your National Final
• Win the National Final to represent your country in the world finals in Miami
• Make it to the World Final and compete across Miami

Open Qualifiers: September 28 – October 25

Think you have what it takes? Play. Qualify. Represent.

Sign up on PlayStation Tournaments: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/tournaments/

Eligibility, dates, rules and prize details vary by region. See the official tournament page for full details: https://playst.cc/red-bull-wings-cup-rules.

GT World Series 2026 | Round 3 - Singapore | Nations Cup [ENGLISH]
The 2026 World Series has now passed its halfway mark, with Round 3 taking place in Singapore.

In the previous Round in Tokyo, reigning champion José Serrano dominated the race right up until the final lap, only to drop to 5th place due to a costly penalty. This dramatic turn of events has significantly impacted the Points Ranking, in a race where the all the Spaniards were expected to hold the advantage.

Will current leader Kylian Drumont, fresh off his victory in the chaotic Round 2, build momentum to pull away from the pack? Will the Spanish drivers stage a comeback? Or will Valerio Gallo, who has been biding his time and closing in on the leaders, finally launch a serious charge?

With the World Finals fast approaching, the battle for the Nations Cup is becoming increasingly unpredictable. Witness how the competition unfolds!

A separate Live Timing stream where viewers can check position changes, sector times, and other race statistics in real-time is also available. We hope you'll enjoy this new feature:

GT World Series 2026 | Round 3 - Singapore | Manufacturers Cup [ENGLISH]
The second half of the 2026 Series is here, where the World Finals action comes to Singapore for the first time.

Drivers race for the pride of their brand in the Manufacturers Cup. In the last live round event of the year, Round 3 sees our drivers from the Americas take the wheel.

Last year's champions Porsche lead the pack after solid wins in Milan and Tokyo. Will they manage to keep their streak running up to the World Finals? Only two points separate 2nd to 5th though, so can their rivals break the chain? This round will set the stage for the World Finals. Be sure to watch it in real-time!

World of Tanks Modern Armor - Steel Asylum Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
https://www.playstation.com/games/world-of-tanks/

Beware, Commander: the battlefield has descended into madness. 

Step into Steel Asylum, the latest season of World of Tanks Modern Armor, and face 100 Stages packed with rewards worthy of those brave enough to confront the unknown. Earn Gold, War Chests, Premium Account time, Premium tanks, and more as you fight your way through a season where fear lurks around every corner. 

Unlock the Season Pass and make your escape with the VCC-80/60, an Escalation Era Light Tank built to strike from the shadows and keep enemies guessing. Looking for an even greater advantage? The Ultimate Season Pass immediately grants you the Serpente — a deadly Tier IX medium tank ready to spread panic across the battlefield — and Desmond "Doc" Rose, a 3D Hero Commander whose unsettling expertise may be exactly what you need to survive the chaos ahead. 

But the horrors of Steel Asylum are only beginning. Prepare for chilling Halloween festivities, incredible Black Friday opportunities, and two mysterious sci-fi events that will challenge your perception of reality itself. 

Face your fears and tame the insanity: the Steel Asylum season begins on October 6 on PlayStation!
